name: Deputy
overview: The Bible presents a deputy as an officer who carries out the responsibilities of a superior when they are absent, as seen in Acts 13:7 and 18:12 where Sergius Paulus and Gallio act as deputies administering authority in their regions. These verses highlight the deputy's role in governance and legal matters, including judgment and maintaining order. Additionally, Acts 13:8 shows that deputies can be targets of spiritual opposition, emphasizing the importance of their faithfulness. Acts 19:38 further illustrates deputies' involvement in legal processes, underscoring their function in upholding the law within the community.
